titulo_en: Mixed conditional: present cause, past result

titulo_es.@es: explicar un resultado pasado con una condición actual
titulo_es.@en: explain a past result with a current condition

texto.@es: En este tipo de condicional mixta, **if + past simple** presenta una situación actual/estable como irreal; **would/could/might have + participio** expresa un resultado pasado imaginario.
texto.@en: In this type of mixed conditional, **if + past simple** presents a current / stable situation as unreal; **would/could/might have + participio** expresses an imaginary past result.

texto.@es: **If I weren't allergic to nuts, I would have tried the dessert yesterday.** = Si no fuera alérgico a los frutos secos, habría probado el postre ayer.
texto.@en: **If I weren't allergic to nuts, I would have tried the dessert yesterday.** = If he was not allergic to nuts, he would have tried dessert yesterday.

titulo.@es: No la confundas con la forma anterior
titulo.@en: Don't confuse her with the old way.

texto.@es: **If + past perfect + would + verbo** enlaza una causa pasada con un resultado actual. Aquí la forma tras **if** es **past simple** y el resultado lleva **would have + participio**.
texto.@en: **If + past perfect + would + verbo** links a past cause with a current result. Here the form after **if** is **past simple** and the result is **would have + participio**.

frases.es: Leo es alérgico a los frutos secos.

frases.en: Yesterday, the café offered him a dessert made with almonds.
frases.es: Ayer, la cafetería le ofreció un postre preparado con almendras.

frases.en: If Leo weren't allergic to nuts, he would have tried the dessert yesterday.
frases.es: Si Leo no fuera alérgico a los frutos secos, habría probado el postre ayer.

pregunta.@es: Completa: If I weren't allergic to nuts, I ___ the dessert yesterday.
pregunta.@en: Complete: If I weren ¥t allergic to nuts, I _ _ _ the dessert yesterday.

explicacion.@es: Es la forma que pide esta estructura.
explicacion.@en: It's the way this structure is asking for.

explicacion.@es: **Would try** expresa una consecuencia presente o futura.
explicacion.@en: **Would try** expresses a present or future consequence.

explicacion.@es: **Will try** expresa una consecuencia real futura.
explicacion.@en: **Will try** expresses a real future consequence.

bloques.frase: If I weren't so cautious, I ___ in that fund last year.

explicacion.@es: **Would have + participio** sitúa el resultado en el pasado.
explicacion.@en: **Would have + participio** places the result in the past.
That would describe an present / future result.
That would be a future prediction.

opciones.explicacion: The first sentence explains his choice.

opciones.texto: He did not like the café.
opciones.explicacion: The text gives no such reason.

opciones.texto: The dessert had already been eaten.
opciones.explicacion: The text does not say that.

pregunta.@es: What happened in the real situation yesterday?
pregunta.@en: What happened in the real situation today?

opciones.texto: Leo chose fruit instead of the dessert.

explicacion.@es: The third sentence gives the actual past choice.
explicacion.@en: The third sentence gives the current past choice.

explicacion.@es: That is what he imagines he would have done if he weren't allergic.
explicacion.@en: That is what he imagines he would have done if he did not allergic.

opciones.texto: He ordered a dessert without nuts.
opciones.explicacion: The text says the dessert had almonds and he chose fruit.

bloques.frase: If I weren't allergic to nuts, I would have tried the dessert yesterday.

opciones.texto: Si no fuera alérgico a los frutos secos, habría probado el postre ayer.

explicacion.@es: La condición es actual/estable; la consecuencia es pasada.
explicacion.@en: The condition is current / stable; the consequence is past.

opciones.texto: Si no hubiera sido alérgico ayer, probaría el postre.

explicacion.@es: El resultado de la frase se refiere a ayer y lleva **would have + participio**.
explicacion.@en: The result of the sentence refers to yesterday and carries **would have + participio**.

opciones.texto: Si no soy alérgico a los frutos secos, probaré el postre mañana.

explicacion.@es: La frase plantea una condición hipotética, no una predicción real.
explicacion.@en: The phrase poses a hypothetical condition, not a real prediction.

bloques.frase: If I weren't so cautious, I would have invested earlier.

traduccion.@es: Si no fuera tan prudente, habría invertido antes.
traduccion.@en: If I wasn't so prudent, I'd have invested before.

pregunta.@es: Which pattern describes a present condition with an imagined past result?
pregunta.@en: When pattern describes a present condition with an imagined past result?

opciones.texto: If + past simple; would have + past participle.

explicacion.@es: La condición es actual/estable y el resultado está en el pasado.
explicacion.@en: The condition is current / stable and the result is in the past.

opciones.texto: If + past perfect; would + base verb.

explicacion.@es: Ese patrón une una causa pasada con un resultado actual.
explicacion.@en: That pattern unites a past cause with a current result.

opciones.texto: If + present simple; will + base verb.

explicacion.@es: Ese patrón expresa una condición futura posible.
explicacion.@en: This pattern expresses a possible future condition.

intro.@es: Lee un caso breve y observa cómo una condición actual puede cambiar lo que ocurrió antes.
intro.@en: Read a brief case and see how a current condition can change what happened before.
